---
name: Feature or API compatibility request
about: Propose a V1 compatibility improvement or alternative design
---

## Use case

Which V1 plugin or workflow would benefit?

## Contract and proposed approach

Describe the V1 behavior and any applicable public V2 interface. What would the adapter preserve? Which differences, errors, permissions or ownership questions remain?

## Verification

Suggest a small test or explain what native evidence would establish the behavior.
